model.note: Pinned to gpt-5.4-mini-2026-03-17, the dated snapshot listed on the OpenAI model page. gpt-5.4-mini is the alias for that snapshot. Iterative and one-shot calls use this same id. temperature and top_p are not sent; the request sets reasoning.effort and max_output_tokens. Function tools with reasoning effort use the Responses API.

budgets.note: The cumulative token cap is provisional until the final freeze. Measured D01 usage was about 82-84k input tokens over 8-9 responses, about 10.5k re-sent per turn, roughly 85% of it cached. Cached tokens still count at full weight toward this cap.
